commit 08488f66b6028761d8eb60a3bddb9aa080a2af4a
Author: Willy Tarreau <w@1wt.eu>
Date:   Fri Jun 26 17:24:54 2020 +0200

    BUG/MINOR: cfgparse: correctly deal with empty lines
